title: CleverBee Tuition
subtitle: Educational Platform & Brand Identity
overview: A comprehensive educational platform combining brand identity design with advanced web development, featuring integrated booking systems, chat functionality, and a complete learning management system.
challenge: Create a professional educational platform that builds trust with parents while providing an intuitive experience for students and seamless booking management for tutors.
solution: Developed a complete brand identity and custom web platform using Webflow with integrated third-party services for calendar management, one-to-one booking, and real-time chat functionality.

sections.title: Brand Strategy
sections.content: The CleverBee brand was designed to convey trust, expertise, and approachability in the education sector. The bee motif represents hard work, community, and the sweet rewards of learning.

sections.caption: Logo design featuring friendly bee character and educational elements

sections.title: Platform Architecture
sections.content: The platform was built with scalability in mind, featuring a custom CMS, integrated booking system, and real-time communication tools. The architecture supports multiple user types with role-based access control.

sections.caption: Main platform interface showing dashboard and navigation

sections.title: User Experience
sections.content: The user experience was designed with three distinct user journeys: parents researching tuition, students accessing learning materials, and tutors managing their schedules and students.

images.caption: Parent portal for tracking student progress

testimonial.quote: The platform has revolutionized how we manage our tuition business. The booking system is seamless, and parents love being able to track their child's progress in real-time.
testimonial.author: Michael Chen
